# NOSOCOMIAL PNEUMONIA WITH ACINETOBACTER BAUMANNII

Infectious Diseases consultation is essential for cases with Acinetobacter which

are often resistant to most therapies.

# Consult ID if Carbapenemase gene detected (IMP, KPC, NDM, OXA-48, VIM)

# Empiric treatment

[Meropenem 2 gm IV q8h R,O](psjizid-meropenem-2gm-iv-q8h)

< OR >

[Ampicillin-sulbactam 3 gm IV q4h R,O](psjizid-ampicillin-sulbactam-3gm-iv-q4h)
